objections.claim: E2 and the release gate rely on GitHub Actions repository/environment variables as Eye-only external trust roots, but the candidate supplies no enforceable custody mechanism and incorrectly asserts repository variables are admin-writable only. GitHub permits users with repository write access (or collaborators on personal repositories) to modify repository variables. Such a writer could replace EYE_AUTHORITY_PUBKEY, CURRENT_AUTHORITY_CHAIN_ROOT, every trusted closure/workflow digest, and RELEASE_SIGNER_FINGERPRINT together, making a rewritten authority chain and release signer self-validating. The plan must place these roots in a genuinely Eye-exclusive external authority store, or constrain and deterministically verify mutation authority so no other principal can update them; branch protection does not protect Actions-variable settings.
